Title: UnitCost is stored when allocation stock comes from LEDGER

Step Action: Go to Shipment Portal and create a new shipment (eg: split shipment across two warehouses); record <ShipmentReference>.
Step Expected: The shipment is created and visible in SHP01, Shipment Portal with Reference = <ShipmentReference>.

Step Action: Trigger determine allocation with stock coming from LEDGER for <ShipmentReference>.
Step Expected: The determine allocation process completes for ShipmentReference = <ShipmentReference>.

Step Action: Query the database table Shp.Allocation: SELECT UnitCost FROM Shp.Allocation WHERE ShipmentReference = <ShipmentReference>.
Step Expected: Exactly one row is returned for ShipmentReference = <ShipmentReference>.

Step Action: Verify UnitCost in the Shp.Allocation database row for <ShipmentReference>.
Step Expected: UnitCost = the value received in the LEDGER allocation response (not NULL); ShipmentReference = <ShipmentReference>.
